tasks.short: Evaluate animal trainability and performance ability

steps.what: Observe animals responding to appropriate assessment activities
Evaluate trainability and ability to perform from observed behaviour

tasks.design: Keep observation and the trainability decision with the trainer. The trainer considers the animal's responses and context before explaining what the assessment can and cannot establish.
tasks.previous_blocker: A history or checklist cannot establish how this animal responds in the current setting.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component is proposed for direct assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Separating temporary responses from consistent capability and recognising assessment limits.
tasks.human_edge: The trainer reads behaviour in context and adjusts the interaction as the animal responds.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in assessment responsibility or authority.

reach.task: Communicate observed behaviour during routine care

evidence.claim: Trainability assessment depends on direct behavioural observation and contextual judgement; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is behavioural assessment and explanation, excluding veterinary assessment and the later training programme.
The owner or existing caretaker provides animal history before assessment; the trainer clarifies it and observes behaviour in s1. No new structured capture or automated capability score is proposed.
No custom build; use existing observation and recording facilities if already present.
Zero incremental upkeep because no component or new recurring work is added.
research_questions: Which observations best distinguish uncertainty from a credible limitation for this intended activity?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; direct assessment and interpretation are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise owners about purchasing particular animals

steps.what: Discuss owner needs, experience and intended animal activities
Advise the owner about specific animal purchase options and limitations

tasks.design: Keep owner questioning and animal-specific advice with the trainer. Species care references in {DOCS} may support the conversation, while the trainer explains uncertainty and the owner makes the purchase decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: A suitable choice depends on the owner, the individual animal and incomplete information.
tasks.enabler_now: Vetted general care information is available, but it does not establish individual suitability.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling owner expectations with realistic care and training demands.
tasks.human_edge: The trainer recognises mismatches and can explain why a desired animal may be unsuitable.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in advisory responsibility or the owner's purchase decision.

reach.task: Explain routine care requirements before an owner commits
reach.learn: Species care requirements and the limits of non-veterinary advice

evidence.claim: LICG provides species-specific care, health and welfare information; that information supports general background rather than individual purchase suitability.
Individual animal purchase advice remains contextual human work; no time reduction is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is purchase advice, excluding sale execution, veterinary examination and a separate trainability assessment.

The owner provides circumstances during s1; existing sellers or caretakers provide available animal information before advice. The trainer checks uncertain statements during s2. No new structured suitability flag, extra owner form or unpaid assessment work is assumed.
Use existing reference material and conversation facilities before any custom build. Medical questions remain for a veterinary professional.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new reference system or recurring process is introduced.
unknowns: Whether an individual assessment is available
research_questions: What missing information most often prevents a defensible recommendation about a particular animal?

already_counted.description: Owner questioning and contextual purchase advice

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0; general care references do not remove owner discussion or individual suitability judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Organise animal show activities, resources and participant arrangements
Conduct the animal show and adapt to live conditions

tasks.design: Keep show coordination and live delivery with the trainer. Existing arrangements in {CALENDAR} and {DOCS} support participants, while the trainer adjusts the event to actual animal and venue conditions.
tasks.previous_blocker: A plan cannot anticipate every change in animal behaviour, participants or the venue.
tasks.enabler_now: No new component is proposed without a demonstrated repeated administrative subtask.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinating people and animals while responding to live conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The trainer recognises when the agreed programme needs to change and communicates that decision.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in show responsibility or live decision authority.

reach.task: Coordinate participant handoffs for an animal demonstration

evidence.claim: Animal show organisation and live conduct depend on contextual coordination and observation; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is the trainer's show organisation and conduct, excluding separate venue operations and animal training.

The event organiser and venue provide existing requirements and constraints before s1; the trainer confirms arrangements during s1. Participants and live animal responses are handled during s2. No new structured readiness flag or unpaid event-staff capture is introduced.
Use existing native calendars and event documents; no custom build or automated scheduling assumption.
Zero incremental upkeep because no additional system or recurring work is introduced.
research_questions: Which recurring coordination problems require clearer roles rather than a new software component?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross and net0. No administrative baseline is invented and live event work remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Nothing changes in assessment, owner advice or show responsibility.
reach: Give clearer care and event handoffs to animal caretakers and recreation staff
role.ambitious_version: A trainer whose advice and live decisions reflect the individual animal and the people involved.
